description: This file defines the VersionSelectorManager class, which manages version selectors for different grain interface types within the Orleans runtime. It provides methods to get, set, and resolve version selectors based on strategies and interface types.

classes.name: VersionSelectorManager
classes.description: Manages version selectors for grain interfaces, allowing retrieval and configuration of versioning strategies.

methods.name: VersionSelectorManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the manager with service provider and options, setting up default and specific version selectors.

methods.name: GetSelector
methods.description: Retrieves the version selector for a given grain interface type, returning the default if none is set.

methods.name: SetSelector
methods.description: Sets the default version selector based on a provided strategy.

methods.name: SetSelector
methods.description: Associates a specific version selector with a grain interface type, or removes it if strategy is null.
